label: prf:descent-condition
title: Proof of Descent condition --- twisted $2$-cocycle
html:
Proof. Proof of Descent condition --- twisted 2-cocycle

Let \{U_i\} be a good cover trivialising the tower. On U_i \cap U_j the gauge transition function g_{ij}^{(n)} patches the connection A_n:

  A_n|_{U_j} =  g_{ij}^{(n)} \cdot A_n|_{U_i} \cdot
  (g_{ij}^{(n)})^{-1} + (g_{ij}^{(n)})^{-1} dg_{ij}^{(n)}.

On a triple overlap U_i \cap U_j \cap U_k, the ordinary cocycle condition g_{ij}^{(n)} \cdot g_{jk}^{(n)} = g_{ik}^{(n)} holds if and only if the connection A_n is globally well-defined at level n without twists. Passing from level n to n{+}1 via the central extension \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} \to \mathfrak{G}_n introduces the 2-morphism twist.

By cocycle deviation as a twisted Čech 2-cocycle, the cocycle deviation at level n+1 satisfies the twisted Čech 2-cocycle equation, with cohomology class in H^2(M, \mathcal{O}_M^{\times}). This is exactly the obstruction class \kappa_n of quantum characteristic classes. It vanishes if and only if the cocycle deviation at level n can be absorbed by the 2-morphism data, meaning the lift from \mathfrak{G}_n to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} is unobstructed.

By [yekutieli2010], this is equivalent to the vanishing of the obstruction class, completing the lifting criterion (Yekutieli lifting). \square
